title: A girl on a bicycle, from the taxi between the base and Saigon
description: A girl of perhaps ten in light polka-dot pyjama-style clothes pedals an adult bicycle straight at the camera down a dirt street, concentrating hard; behind her, blurred, a two-storey building carries two Coca-Cola signs above green roller shutters. "Location is between Ton Suhn Nhut and Saigon. I was in a Taxi cab when taking the photo. The photo is a random person and random shot."
researchNotes: Larry's caption of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0062-c18307725.json). He places it on the road between the base and the city rather than in either, so no place is entered. It sits with the other frames of the way into town — VN-0064 'halfway into Saigon', VN-0073 where he 'probably just stepped out of a Taxi', VN-0067 on the road where they walked to get a taxi. He names the driver he called VC Charlie only at VN-0073, and does not say that this ride, or the other frames, were with him. (2026-09-14: the notes had tied all of them to VC Charlie. The recollection's relatedPeople link to vc-charlie rests on the same inference and is another record's field.)
